mcat_description.short: Industrial Shelters are prefabricated or pre-engineered structural enclosures made from mild steel, FRP, or insulated panel systems, designed to protect industrial equipment, machinery, workers, and materials from weather and environmental exposure. They are sold as complete structural kits or turnkey installations, typically quoted per square foot of covered area.
mcat_description.long: Industrial Shelters encompass a broad range of prefabricated and pre-engineered structures — including steel-framed sheds, FRP dome or barrel-type shelters, PUF/EPS insulated panel shelters, and modular portable shelters — used across manufacturing, warehousing, telecom, defence, and infrastructure sectors. Structural design in India follows IS 800:2007 (steel construction code) for primary framing and IS 875 for load calculations, with materials ranging from mild steel and Corten steel to GI-coated and FRP composites. These structures are factory-fabricated and site-assembled, offering faster construction timelines, lower labour costs, and customisable spans compared to conventional RCC construction. Buyers range from industrial facility managers and EPC contractors to telecom operators and defence procurement agencies, each specifying different material grades, insulation requirements, and structural load capacities.

market_context: Industrial Shelters in the Indian B2B market refer primarily to prefabricated and pre-engineered structural enclosures made from mild steel, FRP, PUF/EPS insulated sandwich panels, or GI/Galvalume-coated steel sheets. Structural design follows IS 800:2007 (General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice) as the primary standard, with load design per IS 875, confirmed by multiple Indian manufacturer and engineering sources. Two dominant material families exist: (1) steel-framed PEB/prefab shelters for large-span factory and warehouse applications, and (2) FRP shelters (dome, barrel, tunnel types) for corrosion-sensitive, lightweight, or defence/remote-terrain applications. PUF and EPS insulated sandwich panel shelters serve temperature-sensitive manufacturing and telecom BTS applications. The market includes a significant telecom sub-segment (BTS/tower shelters) with standardised dimensions quoted per piece. Buyers specify structures by span width, height, load capacity (wind zone, snow load, seismic zone), insulation type, and surface finish (epoxy primer, synthetic enamel, PU coating). The MCAT also attracts a contaminating segment — automated rainout shelters (motorised retractable agricultural research structures) — confirmed by top internal keyword signals; these are unrelated to the core industrial prefab shelter market.
